cohort: 2,855 electronically monitored women delivering over a 12-month period (CFM available for the first 6 months, unavailable for the following 6 months)
finding: There were no significant differences in perinatal outcomes between cohorts with and without access to CFM.
mod_finding: This study found that in birth units staffed for one-to-one care in labor, central fetal monitoring was not associated with an increase in cesarean delivery.
